title: Uncap a spray can and coat a circular plaque
instruction: Remove the cap from the spray-paint can and put it on the blue pad. Spray a blue coat over the single white circular plaque, keeping paint off the surrounding backing. Finish holding the can upright and steady in the left gripper, with its nozzle released and the right hand clear.
context: Repainting a household decorative plaque is a familiar DIY finishing job: remove the protective cap, coat the visible surface evenly and keep the surrounding backing clean. It combines ordinary cap handling and nozzle operation with control of a visibly inspectable coating result.
setup: Fixed seed0, no object jitter. World metres, +x forward, +y left, +z up; table top z=0.7475. Ordinary two YAM arms with parallel grippers and unchanged physical wrist-camera housings. Orange rigid aluminium can:52mm diameter,140mm overall body height,250g, upright root(0.26,0,0.8675), outlet facing+x;80x80x50mm grey riser at(0.26,0,0.7725). Initially seated hollow charcoal plastic cap:60mm diameter,34mm tall,18g, root(0.26,0,0.9545), approximately3mm wall/2mm lid. White plastic button:18mm diameter,10mm tall,3g, root(0.26,0,0.9445),3mm downward travel. Blue cap pad100x100x2mm at(0.34,-0.10,0.7485); grey can pad same size at(0.26,0,0.7485). Fixed white circular plaque:80mm diameter,2mm thick, faces−x, frontx=0.47, centre(y,z)=(-0.035,0.9525); fixed grey backing360x360x12mm centred(0.478,-0.035,0.9525). Steel support behind it at(0.52,-0.035,0.7475):two120x26x6mm feet at localy±0.13,450mm uprights, braces/crossbar/mounts, exact beam geometry in mechanics.py. Work mat570x630x1mm centred(0.30,0,0.7480). No prepared grasp handles, paint strips or removed-cap start.
scoring: End-state score from actual native mechanics and photograph-measurable visible blue area. A surface is painted when its clean-to-blue color blend is at least0.5; simulation dose>=0.04 effective seconds. Plaque and backing use the SAME threshold. Exact circle/cell intersection areas define coverage; visible off-plaque painted backing area must be<=7.5398cm² (15% of the FIXED50.2655cm² plaque area, never emitted paint).0.25:cap detached and>60mm from seat, then parked within45mm horizontally/12mm vertically of pad target, speed<20mm/s.0.50:above plus>=50%plaque coverage and off-plaque area within limit.0.75:above plus>=90%coverage.1.00:above plus can<=10deg from upright/speed<20mm/s, button<0.5mm travel, right TCP>70mm from can/cap, both left fingertips opposing can contacts>=0.1N each/dot<=-0.5, all continuously1.0s between qualifying states. Invalid/missing/nonfinite/nonmonotonic samples, can/cap drop>30mm below table or spraying outside the supported backing/range geometry earn0. Episode retains another1.0s at full score before success termination. See PHOTO_SCORING.md for the real photograph protocol.
run_limit: 1,200 actions (60 seconds at20Hz), shared by model and demo; revised from the previous120-second limit before new model evaluation. Native physics960Hz,48substeps/action.
reset_notes: Use a fresh native reset with cap seated, button released, zero paint dose, original can/pad/plaque layout and seed0. Do not restore a manipulated episode or reuse painted surface state.
fidelity: Rigid compound can/cap/button; uncalibrated cap and nozzle springs and cone deposition. Visible tint is a per10mmcell dose-based blend, not calibrated paint opacity or CFD. Score uses photographed visible area with exact analytic circle intersections; visualization uses128sided circle (<13µm radial discrepancy), gapless cells. Spraying outside the modeled backing/range geometry invalidates the trial; no full-room paint deposition modeled. Clock-only demo commands originated from an offline privileged teacher. Real aerosol trials require product-specific ventilation/PPE/ignition controls; see AEROSOL_PRECAUTIONS.md. The can may remain partly supported by its starting riser while the left fingers grip it; unsupported suspension is not required. Demo footage is labelled offline Storm rendering of exact native poses/paint, model footage is actual noisy RTX RGB. One fixed-seed native demo, not a reliability claim.
